Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is keen to move the POC forward. Procurement asked me to confirm a few items before we raise the PO:

- Fields they need on the PO: PO number, remit_to address, BU code, GL account, and the Redwood sales order number (if available).

Hi Marta — great to hear the team's excited. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) PO fields: we can accept PO number, remit_to, BU code, GL account. Please include a field called "Sales Order" or "SO#" where you can paste the SOW id; if you don't have an SO yet that's fine, we can map after SOW sign.

2) Net terms: our standard is net30. We can make an exception to net45 for POCs where there is a clear path to a commercial commitment (signed SOW + purchase order tied to an account-level commitment). For HealthHaven, we can offer net45 for the POC if you: (a) send a PO referencing the SOW, and (b) sign the attached MOU that outlines the pilot scope and a 90-day conversion window to a committed contract.

3) Invoice cadence: we can issue consolidated monthly invoices per PO (one invoice per PO that aggregates subscriptions/usage across business units). We do need a single billing contact and one PO id to tie the invoices to.

4) Vendor setup: attaching our W-9 and a one-page vendor onboarding checklist. Please send your PO template and the remit address you want on file.

Discounts/packaging: for pilots we typically don't apply standard volume discounts. However, we can:
- Offer a one-time 5% credit against the first invoice if HealthHaven signs an annual commitment within 90 days of pilot close.
- Consider a tiered discount (7.5%–10%) once committed annual spend thresholds are met; those require an upfront commitment and a contract amendment.

Next steps: 
- Can you send your PO template and billing contact? (I've attached a sample PO template that shows the fields we map.)
- If you'd like the net45 exception, we'll draft a short MOU and route to your legal.

I'll attach the SOW draft and W-9 in a follow-up.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
bc@redwood.ai

Proposed concession: allow net45 for the pilot under these guardrails:
- Require signed MOU referencing the POC scope and conversion window (90 days).
- PO must include the BU code + remit address and be sent to billing@redwood.ai.
- Invoices issued monthly, due net45; if payment is late >30 days past due, suspend pilot access until balance is resolved.
- Offer a one-time 5% credit on the first invoice if they convert to a paid annual within 90 days of pilot completion.

Pricing/discount note: do we want to stretch to 7.5% here to close? Vivek — thoughts on margin impact if we give 7.5% for a guaranteed 12-month commit within 90 days?

Grace — can you confirm legal is fine with the MOU language that allows net45 for onboarding (we'll need the suspension clause and conversion trigger)?

— Ben

Hi Marta — thanks for the note and for sending the template earlier. We've reviewed with legal and billing and can proceed as follows:

1) PO format: We can consume your PO with the fields requested (PO#, remit_to, BU code, GL account). Please include the field "SOW / Sales Order" and insert the SOW id once signed. Send the PO to billing@redwood.ai and cc your internal billing contact.

2) Net terms & onboarding: We will accept net45 for the POC under these conditions: (a) Redwood receives a signed PO referencing the attached MOU/SOW, (b) HealthHaven provides a billing contact and vendor remit address, and (c) payment follows consolidated monthly invoices tied to the single PO id. Per legal we added a standard suspension clause if invoices are more than 30 days overdue.

3) Invoice cadence: We'll issue a single consolidated invoice per PO on a monthly cadence; that invoice will aggregate charges across the pilot's BU codes as you requested.

4) Discounts: For this pilot we can offer a one-time 5% credit applied to the first post-signing invoice if HealthHaven executes a 12-month commitment within 90 days of pilot completion. We are not extending deeper tiered discounts for the POC stage without a baseline committed spend. If you need a firmer commercial incentive, we can look at a 7.5% conversion credit tied to a minimum annual commitment of $225k.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf, Redwood_W9.pdf.

Next steps: 
- Please return your PO (HH_PO_template.csv) with the PO# and billing contact to billing@redwood.ai.
- I'll route the MOU to your legal after you confirm net45 ok with your team.

If you'd like to lock a specific billing calendar (e.g., preferred invoice day), let me know and we'll attempt to match within our billing cycle.
